final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS order_type FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault COLLATE BINARY = o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY), grouped AS (SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM matched GROUP BY order_type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM grouped), kept AS (SELECT g.record_count, a.avg_count FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE a.avg_count IS NOT NULL AND g.record_count > a.avg_count) SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_kept_count, AVG(record_count - avg_count) AS average_excess_overall_average FROM kept
